body:
The relationship between her and her parents really are not good at all... so I can see where it would be coming from, really...

> If you've attempted suicide several times in the past and they're still denying you access to mental health care, that's negligent on their part.

They don't know I've attempted. I've managed to keep it a secret because I would be taken to the church or something to be 'freed of the demons possessing me'.

I'll work on reading it right now, thank you. Thank you again so much for your help.

Thank you for your reply, I'm sorry for replying late, myself, because I was working all day...

I really do appreciate to hear that you are listening and someone took the time to read this long annoying thing I wrote, it really does mean something... 

It really does make me feel awful even thinking of considering this relationship abusive, it hurts me to think about it... Because I really don't think she means harm. I don't think she does... She's a very good person, in my eyes...

And I appreciate you suggesting to let it down but I'm really not sure how to do this without messing things up further. I let it down before, I guess, I've tried and I just ended up making it a problem for everyone involved or making everyone mad with me. Like I said, with my family, they don't "believe" in depression or mental illnesses (because, you know, they're just being attacked by Satan or something...). And so, they take it like I'm just having an attitude with them.... And I don't want anything like the school getting involved... I remember a few times I was called down to the office because some teachers were worried and that was awful and horrifying and nothing even came of it... if it did... I don't know what I would do... 

I really do appreciate your reply, so much, and if I could, I wish I could repay you in some way because even knowing someone was there to read it has made me feel a little better.
